title: The Clock of Vilna
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: August Dravenmoor, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
